sample_unit: PubMed abstracts screened (87 relevant abstracts for extraction; 5 clinical research coordinators for usability)
unlisted_practices: Using an LLM pipeline for automated abstract screening and structured information extraction from the literature, evaluated against an expert-reviewed gold standard
Interactive dashboard for visualizing research trends with usability testing (PSSUQ) among clinical research coordinators

screen.reason: The study evaluates an LLM-based tool (RaCE-X) for biomedical literature screening and oncology evidence extraction, including usability testing with clinical research coordinators, but it evaluates tool performance and usability rather than testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
